body:
Solace's own crate isn't rustfmt-clean (about 295 hunks across 21 files with its `rustfmt.toml`, D-158 point 5). That is why `submit` formats only changed items and `format` with no module is refused (D-180 point 2). As a result, every first edit of an old item also reformats it, which adds noise to that task's review.

### Change

- Run `format <module>` on each module of `solace-cli` that rustfmt would change, one module per call so each change is checked and recorded on its own. Make no other edits.
- Where a module gets long-line notes, split the literal or fix the indentation that rustfmt left alone.
- Done when the `cargo-fmt-check` recipe passes.

### Out of scope

- Changing `submit`, the no-module refusal, or the gates. Once the crate is clean, per-item formatting on `submit` keeps it clean.

### Tests

- `cargo-fmt-check` passes.
- `test` passes, with the same results as before.
title: format: make Solace's crate rustfmt-clean
